name: Overhead press
summary: Dumbbells at the shoulders, press straight up until the arms lock out overhead, lower.
setup: Face the phone, dumbbells at shoulder height, elbows under the wrists. Press straight up until the arms lock out, then lower to the shoulders.
brief: Stand with the dumbbells at shoulder height, elbows under the wrists. Press straight up until the arms lock out, then lower to the shoulders.
why: Facing the phone the wrists travel from the shoulders to straight overhead each rep, and the shoulders hiking up to help is measured as the ear–shoulder gap closing.
contraindications: Shoulder pain overhead; lower back pain with the press.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Lower back arching
faults.tip: Brace the stomach and squeeze the glutes so the press does not come from leaning back.

faults.label: Arching the lower back
faults.tip: Leaning back under the weight is how the lower back gets hurt. Brace and press straight up.

faults.label: Not locking out
faults.tip: Finish with the biceps by the ears.

faults.label: Not locking out overhead
faults.cue: Arms straight, biceps by the ears
faults.tip: Finish with the arms straight and the weight over the middle of the head.
